scope: M14 current native live audio load recovery; M09/M17 not accepted

reproduction.before: Actual direct and universal audio transport disconnects produce Chromium NotSupportedError. The rejected play promise overwrote the existing useful failure message with Failed to load because no supported source was found.
reproduction.after: NotSupportedError uses the same plain-language explanation as the exhausted media-error path. Typed service errors and AbortError handling remain intact.

method.environment: Actual Electron main/preload and built production renderer; isolated app data with a copy of the already-authorized protected Jellyfin connection. Native1280×720/100%, muted audio. Shared provider Keychain adapter disabled.
method.fault: Audio requests establish request-owned TCP connections to the real server, then deliberately destroy the sockets. Actual ECONNRESET propagates through the media protocol. It is controlled per-request fault injection, not an actual server or whole-network outage.
method.recovery: Restore normal read transport; actual universal endpoint supplies native decodable audio. Preparation telemetry records false,true exactly once for initial fallback and successful direct-only fallback.
method.queue: Compare exact saved trackIds and currentIndex after failed load, Retry and Skip; native player controls supply all commands.
method.safety: GET/HEAD only. No login, server/library mutation or provider request. Protected connection bytes match before/after. Driver closes the app in finally.
